name: codex-mnemosyne
description: Mnemosyne primary-memory integration for Codex. Hooks SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, and SessionEnd to durable native ingest and bounded recall. Built-in Codex memory stays disabled; Mnemosyne is the sole persistent memory provider.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent cross-session memory via Mnemosyne native ingest and bounded recall
interface.longDescription: Hooks Codex's lifecycle (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SessionEnd) to Mnemosyne's durable native ingest and bounded recall. The adapter is fail-open for Codex; memory failures surface as visible non-sensitive warnings. Uses a 0600 transport-only spool for failed delivery and never parses transcripts. Mnemosyne remains the sole persistent memory provider.
capabilities: Durable event ingest with stable event IDs
Fail-open with visible structured failure reporting
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about my preferences?
